title: CI-Driven Automation
objective: Place validation and controlled execution in a delivery pipeline.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Jenkins and other CI systems can check out infrastructure code, install pinned dependencies, lint it, perform syntax checks, run tests, and publish results.
Deployment jobs need protected credentials, approval policy, environment limits, concurrency controls, and durable logs. A failed quality gate must prevent execution.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Place validation and controlled execution in a delivery pipeline.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
ci_pipeline:
  checkout: versioned_source
  lint: required
  tests: required
  approval: protected_environment
  deploy_after_success: true
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
